name: Local Toby — Tab Collections
description: Local-first tab & collection manager. Save, organize, and restore tabs across spaces. All data stays on your machine — no account, no cloud.

save-current-tab.description: Save the current tab to the active collection

save-all-tabs.description: Save all tabs in the current window to a new collection

toggle-side-panel.description: Toggle the Open Tabs side panel

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' chrome-extension: data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'
